paths_to_scan.description: List of directories or file paths to scan for duplicates.

ignore_empty.description: Whether to ignore empty files (equivalent to -minsize 1).

min_size.description: Minimum file size in bytes to consider.

max_size.description: Maximum file size in bytes to consider. 0 disables this check.

remove_ident_inode.description: Remove items with identical inode and device ID.

checksum_algorithm.description: Checksum algorithm to use: md5, sha1, sha256, or sha512.

deterministic.description: Enable deterministic sorting for files of equal rank.

sleep_ms.description: Milliseconds to sleep between reading files (0, 1-5, 10, 25, 50, 100).

dry_run.description: Display what would be done without performing actions.
